question: Can the strong Goldbach conjecture be proved: every even integer n >= 4 is the sum of two primes?

tasks.title: 权威文献与历史结果地图
tasks.acceptance: 记录检索式、数据库、日期、覆盖限制；至少核读筛法、圆法、弱哥德巴赫和有限验证的主要原始来源。
tasks.note: Twelve provider-tracked searches, curated PDF corpus, SHA-256 manifest, and literature map completed.

tasks.title: 命题定义与已知边界审计
tasks.acceptance: 精确定义强哥德巴赫命题，区分弱哥德巴赫、陈氏定理、几乎所有偶数结果和有限计算验证，不发生逻辑偷换。
tasks.note: Strong/weak, p+P2, exceptional-set, and finite-computation boundaries audited.

tasks.title: 筛法与奇偶障碍路线分析
tasks.acceptance: 给出候选推导的逐步证明义务，并明确筛法奇偶障碍在哪里阻止从素数+至多两个素数因子提升到素数+素数。
tasks.note: Sieve route reduced to explicit parity-sensitive obligations; no closure found.

tasks.title: 圆法与小弧误差路线分析
tasks.acceptance: 推导奇异级数主项的适用范围并指出二元问题中小弧界不足的精确证明义务。
tasks.note: Binary circle-method route reduced to a missing pointwise minor-arc bound; no closure found.

tasks.title: 候选证明反例优先审查
tasks.acceptance: 逐条检查量词、均匀性、异常零、从平均到逐点、从几乎所有到所有、计算尾界等常见缺口；发现缺口即记录。
tasks.note: Counterexample-first audit integrated with explicit failure gates.

tasks.title: 有限范围独立计算核验
tasks.acceptance: 使用独立实现验证声明范围内的偶数均有素数分解，记录范围、算法、哈希与运行环境；明确有限验证不是一般证明。
tasks.note: Completed by R001.

tasks.title: 中文综合研究报告
tasks.acceptance: 以 verdict 开头，列出命题契约、已知定理、候选路线、致命缺口、证据与复现说明；不得声称解决未解决的问题。
tasks.note: Chinese synthesis report completed with INCONCLUSIVE verdict and reproducibility instructions.

tasks.title: 最小反例与素数反射覆盖路线
tasks.acceptance: 从反例 N 导出可核验的反射集合/小素因子覆盖条件，区分真正新引理、筛法奇偶障碍的改写与等价重述。
tasks.note: Reflection-cover reduction and log(2) constant-separation proof obligations documented.

tasks.title: 例外传播与局部稳定性计算攻击
tasks.acceptance: 预先定义传播候选、在明确有限区间计算表示函数及邻域统计，给出最小反例或覆盖范围；不得从数值模式推一般结论。
tasks.note: Completed by R002.

tasks.title: 原创路线扩展报告
tasks.acceptance: 给出候选方案、充分引理链、每步技术强度、数值反证和最终 verdict；若未闭合必须指出唯一或最小未证桥梁。
tasks.note: Original-route extension report completed with failed proxies, finite evidence, and the remaining pointwise parity bridge.

tasks.title: 深筛奇偶偏置全区间重算
tasks.acceptance: 对 10,000 至 100,000 的每个偶数无遗漏计算 N^(1/3) 深筛幸存者中的素数/半素数比例，修复固定模 20 抽样偏差并记录最坏点。
tasks.note: Completed by R003.

tasks.title: 大范围深筛常数分离抽样
tasks.acceptance: 在至多 2,000,000 的多剩余类、固定种子样本上测量深筛后半素数/素数比，比较启发式 log 2 常数并保存最坏样例；仅作路线选择证据。
tasks.note: Completed by R004.

tasks.title: 深筛素数多数命题的小数边界攻击
tasks.acceptance: 对 4 至 9,998 的每个偶数检查深筛后素数幸存者是否多于半素数；若失败记录最小反例，若通过仅作为有限证据。
tasks.note: Completed by R005.

tasks.title: 构造性证明链与单一桥梁引理
tasks.acceptance: 从深筛分类出发给出逐步证明、精确筛权、主项常数与有限区间拼接；除一个明确标注的点态双线性桥梁外不得隐藏证明义务。
tasks.note: Completed by R006.

tasks.title: BL桥梁的因子区间分解与误差预算
tasks.acceptance: 给出S_z的精确dyadic/Buchstab分解，核实log 2主常数与局部因子归一化，证明可封闭的外围因子区间，并把剩余点态核心压缩到明确参数区间；不得把Goldbach正性作为假设。
tasks.note: Exact band decomposition, finite-scale constant audit, R007 profile, source extraction, and trilinear core C_{1/2} completed; the central pointwise dispersion estimate remains unproved.

tasks.title: 对称有序因子权与奇偶破缺尝试
tasks.acceptance: 构造并逐点证明深筛素数选择的对称卷积权，严格控制平方修正；分析其Buchstab/Chen switching参数，核验可用的asymptotic-sieve或parity-breaking定理，并明确它是否缩小C_{1/2}。
tasks.note: Direction-weight rigidity W_h=C_z/2, exact symmetric identity, R008 audit, two-sided Buchstab switching, first-layer ell*m<=sqrt(N), migrated quotient-weight core C_sym, and parity-breaking theorem applicability audit completed; SD/PB-FI/PB-FM remain unproved.

tasks.title: 商权色散的谱与Kloosterman展开
tasks.acceptance: 从SD的固定N商权素数和出发，严格完成Vaughan/Poisson或Linnik dispersion展开，识别可由现有谱大筛、Kuznetsov、BFI或三线性Kloosterman定理控制的区域；明确剩余相关和、指数预算与是否循环，不得假设Goldbach正性。
tasks.note: Derived rough Titchmarsh identity, reduced inverse phase, KSD obligation, spectral modulus kappa geometry, raw Bettin-Chandee cancellation, narrow kappa<17/33 dispersion candidate, shallow-sieve shell audit, R009, and nine-source applicability matrix; full q-dependent quotient-weight core remains unproved.

tasks.title: 真实商权的低秩卷积分解
tasks.acceptance: 保留(ell,m) switching标签，构造或排除对c_{ell,m}(n)的统一有限低秩/可分离展开；量化rank、系数范数、Buchstab层数与dyadic参数，并逐项核对Fouvry-Radziwill、Bettin-Chandee或Lichtman型定理，至少严格关闭一个此前未关闭的kappa>1/2子区，或给出精确失败边界。
tasks.note: Exact minimum-prime-factor aggregation removes the first unweighted switching-label coupling; distinguished prime-indicator and Lambda analogues; established polylog staircase/L2 bookkeeping, the separable 55/112<u<=1/2 match, and terminal-factor budget t<=N^(1/66). Independent source and falsifier audits find no closed theorem for v_((N-ab)/d); K010 remains unresolved and verdict stays INCONCLUSIVE.

tasks.title: 以一侧上筛消除末端商权
tasks.acceptance: 对深半素数修正按a,b尺度分块，以Selberg或beta上筛直接控制1_P(N-ab)，只调用可分离卷积在ab=N(mod d)中的分布；精确核算筛维数、level、局部因子、薄层u>55/112的总常数及与1-log(2)余量的关系。若不能缩小核心区，给出常数或参数上的严格失败边界，不得把上界筛当作素数渐近式。
tasks.note: One-sided beta sieve removes the terminal quotient weight formally and yields dimension-one local factors. R011 and independent derivation give thin-layer constant 4/57+2log(57/55)=0.141611, 3.96 times its predicted mass. Fouvry-Radziwill's literal |shift|<=X condition fails on N>CAB blocks; Li 2024 is only a specialized near-N replacement. The sharp BL2 constant and full fixed-N interface remain unresolved.

tasks.title: Li大移位接口下的带符号Chen切换
tasks.acceptance: 从深半素数修正的u分块出发，构造至少一层保留符号的Buchstab/Chen switching恒等式；逐字段匹配Li 2024 Lemma 2.2或其他真正大移位分布定理，推导可复现的连续常数泛函并优化参数。必须判断是否能把W019的beta上筛膨胀压入Goldbach正余量；若失败，给出精确的覆盖缺口、符号损失或常数下界。
tasks.note: Derived an exact three-step +,-,+,- Buchstab identity and conditional Li-style F/f functional. Direct Li 2.2 boxes cover only ab=N(1-o(1)); Lichtman reparameterization would require a new transfer to modified Iwaniec weights. R013 gives cube-root lower-sieve gap 6697/96000, and P1/P2 separation remains open. K012 unresolved; verdict INCONCLUSIVE.

tasks.title: Lichtman大移位到Li修改筛权的尺度转移
tasks.acceptance: 以x=tN、1/2<=t<=1和固定余数a=N重述Lichtman 2023 Proposition 3.1及其闭合步骤，证明或排除对Li 2024 Lemma 2.2修改Iwaniec权的统一转移；必须追踪alpha、theta、nu、well-factorability、prime-box宽度、t一致性及误差求和。若转移成立，量化覆盖的(u,t)区域和下筛s>2区域；若失败，定位首个不能满足的明文假设。
tasks.note: Completed compact-t bare Type-II transfer with corrected joint eta-epsilon budget; fixed-a programmable prime-product template verified in Lichtman 2025. Full uniform-a modified-weight transfer remains W022.

tasks.title: Lichtman 2025可编程因子化的统一大余数升级
tasks.acceptance: 逐字段重建Lichtman 2025 Proposition 5.5与Corollary 5.6的证明输入，将固定余数a的分布定理替换为Lichtman 2023对0<|a|<x^(1+epsilon)一致的Propositions 3.1、3.2、5.2；对每个programmable-factorability/anatomy分支核验变量范围、模数分解、互素条件、系数独立性、|a|^theta预算和prime-product窄盒求和。若不能闭合，必须给出首个明文失败分支及精确指数不等式；不得把条件命题写成Goldbach证明。
tasks.note: Completed exact feasibility proof for the combined programmable and uniform-large-shift exponent systems. The upgrade remains unproved at the sequence level: an admissible numeric triple is not an actual modified-weight convolution witness. Proposition 6.1 route requires rho>(80/3)epsilon_u plus level/support losses and a full HB coefficient ledger.

tasks.title: Proposition 6.1的序列级分组见证与prime-product系数闭合
tasks.acceptance: 从Lichtman 2023 Proposition 6.1的support factorization和Lichtman 2025 Lemma 5.3的anatomy卷积构造出发，对一个固定anatomy窄盒证明或排除uniform-a的序列级三重卷积分解；必须联立rho>(80/3)epsilon_u、vartheta>=19101/32000+2rho、Q_i支撑膨胀、分组稳定性与(q_i,a)=1。随后至少对一个固定k prime-product盒写出完整HB中变量/一长/两长分类及1-bounded或divisor-bounded系数处理。失败时给出最早不可恢复的明文假设。
tasks.note: Exact rho>(80/3)epsilon_u and positive level/HB budgets verified. Source and falsifier audits show the claimed local closure still needs box-stable analytic margins, internal multinomial normalization, and a divisor-bounded extension of the growing-residue Type-II theorem; K015 remains unresolved.

tasks.title: 全anatomy覆盖与divisor-bounded Type-II修复
tasks.acceptance: 对修改Iwaniec权的每个anatomy分支建立单变量、三变量增强、smooth/低level或Proposition 3.2覆盖表；同时逐段证明或排除Lichtman 2023 Proposition 5.2在固定阶divisor-bounded Heath-Brown系数下的uniform growing-residue扩展。必须处理上角稳定分区、两层support膨胀、重复盒multinomial归一化和边界盒；若失败，给出首个具体未覆盖向量或证明中的不可吸收项。

tasks.acceptance: 以z=N^(1/3)的精确恒等式G=T_z-S_z为起点，在同一归一化下证明或排除存在常数ell,u满足T_z>=ell(1+log2)M、S_z<=u log2 M且u/ell<(1+log2)/log2。必须保留Buchstab/Chen符号到联合估计以后，禁止逐盒绝对值冒充奇偶分离；若失败，给出首个具体核或指数/常数障碍，并审计固定N量词。

tasks.title: Li式(29)的G1分片Taylor定向证书

sources.citation: H. A. Helfgott, The ternary Goldbach conjecture is true, arXiv:1312.7748v2 (2014).
sources.note: Proves every odd integer greater than 5 is a sum of three primes; explicitly distinguishes the still stronger binary problem.

sources.citation: H. A. Helfgott, Minor arcs for Goldbach's problem, arXiv:1205.5252.
sources.note: Provides explicit minor-arc bounds used for the ternary, not binary, Goldbach theorem.

sources.citation: H. A. Helfgott, Major arcs for Goldbach's problem, arXiv:1305.2897.
sources.note: Provides explicit major-arc estimates used in the ternary proof.

sources.citation: J. Wu, Chen's double sieve, Goldbach's conjecture and the twin prime problem, Acta Arith. 114 (2004), 215-273; arXiv:0705.1652.
sources.note: Defines the binary representation count D(N), improves upper bounds and prime-plus-P2 lower bounds; does not prove D(N)>0.

sources.citation: T. Oliveira e Silva, S. Herzog, S. Pardi, Empirical verification of the even Goldbach conjecture and computation of prime gaps up to 4×10^18, Math. Comp. 83 (2014), 2033-2060, DOI:10.1090/S0025-5718-2013-02787-1.
sources.note: Exhaustive computation through 4×10^18; decisive only for that finite interval.

sources.citation: M. Bordignon, D. R. Johnston, V. Starichkova, An explicit version of Chen's theorem and the linear sieve, arXiv:2207.09452v6 (2025).
sources.note: Proves every even N>exp(exp(32.7)) is prime plus a square-free P2; says complete binary Goldbach remains out of reach.

sources.citation: H. A. Helfgott, The ternary Goldbach problem, arXiv:1404.2224v2 (2014).
sources.note: Survey distinguishing weak and strong Goldbach and explaining explicit circle-method thresholds.

sources.citation: G. Bhowmik and L. Grimmelt, The exceptional set of the Goldbach problem, arXiv:2607.27282v2 (2026).
sources.note: Current exceptional-set survey/new results; confirms pointwise binary conjecture remains open. Preprint.

sources.citation: J. Pintz, A new explicit formula in the additive theory of primes with applications II: The exceptional set in Goldbach's problem, arXiv:1804.09084v2.
sources.note: Gives E(X)<X^0.72 beyond an ineffective threshold; still permits infinitely many exceptions.

sources.citation: G. Bhowmik and K. Halupczok, Asymptotics of Goldbach Representations, Adv. Stud. Pure Math. 84 (2020), DOI:10.2969/aspm/08410001.
sources.note: Reviews average and summatory Goldbach asymptotics; average statements do not imply pointwise positivity.

sources.citation: G. Bhowmik, A.-M. Ernvall-Hytönen, N. Palojärvi, Explicit estimates for the Goldbach summatory functions, arXiv:2411.00323v2 (2025).
sources.note: Explicit estimates for summatory/average functions; not a pointwise proof.

sources.citation: D. R. Heath-Brown, A parity problem from sieve theory, Mathematika 29 (1982), DOI:10.1112/S0025579300012109.
sources.note: DOI metadata only. An incorrect local binding to the Lichtman 2025 linear-sieve PDF was removed on 2026-09-07; the Heath-Brown 1982 full text is not currently stored locally and must not be described as locally reviewed. Technical source on the sieve parity problem; used only to calibrate the p+P2 to p+p gap until the correct text is acquired.

sources.citation: J. B. Friedlander and H. Iwaniec, Exceptional zeros, sieve parity, Goldbach, 2022, DOI:10.2140/ent.2022.1.13.
sources.note: Survey of exceptional zeros, sieve parity, and Goldbach interactions.

sources.citation: H. L. Montgomery and R. C. Vaughan, The exceptional set in Goldbach's problem, Acta Arith. 27 (1975), 353-370, DOI:10.4064/aa-27-1-353-370.
sources.note: Exceptional-set theorem with power saving; does not show the exceptional set is empty.

sources.citation: A. Alsetri and X. Shao, Density versions of the binary Goldbach problem, Acta Arith. (2025), arXiv:2405.18576, DOI:10.4064/aa240615-19-9.
sources.note: Shows sharp limitations of density/transfer arguments for pointwise binary Goldbach.

sources.citation: Runbo Li, On Chen's theorem, Goldbach's conjecture and almost prime twins II, arXiv:2405.05727v4 (2025).
sources.note: Theorem 1.1 gives D_{1,2}(N) >= 1.9728 C(N)N/log^2N and uses special weighted distribution exponent 19101/32000; it does not separate prime from semiprime reflections.

sources.citation: J. Friedlander and H. Iwaniec, Asymptotic sieve for primes, Annals of Mathematics 148 (1998), 1041-1065; arXiv:math/9811186.
sources.note: Theorems 1-2 require level D>x^(2/3) and a Mobius-twisted bilinear axiom; these hypotheses are not known for the fixed-N reflected-prime sequence.

sources.citation: K. Ford and J. Maynard, On the theory of prime producing sieves, arXiv:2407.14368 (2024).
sources.note: Type I/II criteria and countermodels show that narrow bilinear information does not suffice; the safe general-sequence region remains unverified for a_N.

sources.citation: J. Friedlander and H. Iwaniec, The polynomial X^2+Y^4 captures its primes, Annals of Mathematics 148 (1998), 945-1040; arXiv:math/9811185.
sources.note: Successful parity-sensitive sieve uses Gaussian norm structure and character cancellation unavailable for N-mn.

sources.citation: D. R. Heath-Brown and X. Li, Prime values of a^2+p^4, arXiv:1504.00531v3.
sources.note: Parity-breaking Type II estimate relies on Gaussian-integer structure and cannot be transferred directly to the Goldbach reflection sequence.

sources.citation: H. A. Helfgott, The parity problem for irreducible cubic forms, arXiv:math/0501177.
sources.note: Mobius cancellation uses cubic-number-field ideal factorization; no corresponding algebraic model is known for N-p.

sources.citation: J. Friedlander and H. Iwaniec, Exceptional zeros, sieve parity, Goldbach, Essential Number Theory 1 (2022), 13-40.
sources.note: Survey clarifies that positive-sieve improvements and exceptional-zero arguments do not furnish an unconditional binary Goldbach bridge.

sources.citation: J. Maynard, Primes in arithmetic progressions to large moduli I: fixed residue classes, arXiv:2006.06572.
sources.note: Beyond-square-root distribution for fixed residue classes and moduli with convenient factors; does not allow the actual joint quotient weight.

sources.citation: J. Maynard, Primes in arithmetic progressions to large moduli II: well-factorable estimates, arXiv:2006.07088.
sources.note: Level 3/5 for triply well-factorable weights and fixed residue class; not a general quotient-weight theorem.

sources.citation: J. Maynard, Primes in arithmetic progressions to large moduli III: uniform residue classes, arXiv:2006.08250.
sources.note: Uniform variable residue classes for structured factorable moduli; quotient-weight dependence remains outside the hypotheses.

sources.citation: J. D. Lichtman, Primes in arithmetic progressions to large moduli and shifted primes without large prime factors, arXiv:2211.09641.
sources.note: Structured four-linear modulus weights with fixed shift; useful background but not directly applicable to a=N.

sources.citation: J. D. Lichtman, Primes in arithmetic progressions to large moduli, and bounds for sums of two primes, arXiv:2309.08522.
sources.note: Uniform large-shift distribution to level 153/256 for triply well-factorable weights and Goldbach upper bounds; no parity-breaking quotient-weight lower bound.

sources.citation: S. Drappeau, Sums of Kloosterman sums in arithmetic progressions, and the error term in the dispersion method, arXiv:1504.05549.
sources.note: Kuznetsov-based estimates for structured convolution and Kloosterman sums; conditions do not permit arbitrary q-dependent quotient weights.

sources.citation: S. Bettin and V. Chandee, Trilinear forms with Kloosterman fractions, arXiv:1502.00769; Advances in Mathematics 328 (2018).
sources.note: Gives genuine cancellation for tensor-product trilinear inverse phases, but not the full prime-weighted dispersion chain.

sources.citation: E. Assing, V. Blomer, and J. Li, Uniform Titchmarsh divisor problems, arXiv:2005.13915.
sources.note: Uniform fixed-N asymptotic for Lambda(p)tau(N-p); does not admit the deep roughness weight R_z.

sources.citation: E. Fouvry and M. Radziwill, Another application of Linnik's dispersion method, arXiv:1812.00562.
sources.note: Complete dispersion for narrow separable Type-II convolutions, yielding only a candidate window kappa<17/33 under unverified coefficient conditions.

sources.citation: Alexandru Pascadi, On the exponents of distribution of primes and smooth numbers, arXiv:2505.00653v2 (2025).
sources.note: Propositions 4.4-4.5 keep strict tensor-product outer and inner weights; the smooth-number arbitrary-outer-weight result relies on flexible factorization and does not cover label-dependent rough quotients.

sources.citation: Runbo Li, Primes in arithmetic progressions to large moduli and refinements of Harman's sieve, arXiv:2602.20917v6 (2026).
sources.note: Harman-sieve bilinear and trilinear estimates retain separable convolution weights and fixed roughness conditions; no outer-label-dependent terminal quotient coefficient is allowed.

sources.citation: Zhiyuan Yang, Convolution-type Bombieri-Vinogradov theorem with well-factorable weights, and its applications, arXiv:2608.13299v1 (2026).
sources.note: Closest positive interface found: allows divisor-bounded gamma_d times well-factorable lambda_q, but requires product separation and inner convolution/roughness independent of (q,d), so it does not cover c_{q,d}(n).

sources.citation: J. D. Lichtman, A modification of the linear sieve, and the count of twin primes, Algebra & Number Theory 19 (2025), 1-38; arXiv:2109.02851v2.
sources.note: W021/W022 source read on 2026-09-03. Proposition 5.5 and Corollary 5.6 explicitly extend programmable/modified Iwaniec weights to narrow products of k primes, but only for fixed residue a with implied constants depending on a. Proposition 5.4 gives the corresponding prime-AP anatomy statement. Uniform growing residue a=N at product scale x=tN still requires replacing the fixed-a distribution input with Lichtman 2023 uniform-large-shift machinery.
